'''Imperial Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor''', or '''Imperial Forest Camouflage Armor''' for short, was a type of [[battle armor]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A recent development from Imperial Ordinance during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], this [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was not routinely issued to troops. Another form of this armor was [[Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor]].

==Description==
Created for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout Trooper]] [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] Camouflage [[Armor/Legends|Armor]] was a type of [[battle armor]] which closely resembled the [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by standard Imperial scout troopers. However, instead of a clean [[Color/Legends|white]] appearance, the armor was patterned in a mottled greenish-brown hue, which allowed it to blend into the forest environments for which it was designed. The armor also resembled the type of [[Swamptrooper armor|armor]] worn by [[wetland assault stormtrooper]]s early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
Imperial Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor, or Imperial Forest Camouflage Armor for short, was a recent development from Imperial Ordinance which saw limited use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. It was not routinely issued to Imperial troops, yet at least one individual, the recipient of an [[Imperial Medallion of Service]], was awarded the armor after loyally aiding influential figures at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], including [[Kaja Or'Zee]], [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="AED" />

Although this armor was designed for use by Imperial forces, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] named [[Delia Visi]] was known to wear a dark colored suit of Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor, albeit without the helmet. After her involvement in the "[[Rori Incident]]," which resulted in the bombing of an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] facility in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], she became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top 10 most wanted fugitives.<ref name="Fugitives">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67706&month=042008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Fugitives}}</ref> Eventually, a unidentified [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked her down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her.<ref name="AED" />

Another variant of this armor, called [[Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor]],<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> also saw use by the Empire during the Galactic Civil War. This other version of armor more closely resembled the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] likewise made use of their own type of forest camouflage armor, known as [[Rebel assault armor|Rebel Assault Forest Camouflage Armor]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[W:c:swg:Imperial Forest Camouflage armour|Imperial Forest Camouflage Armor]] first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> On [[September 12]], [[2007]], with the release of [[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12: ''Masters of the Wild'']], this [[W:c:swg:Armor|armor]] was included as the [[W:c:swg:Quest reward|reward]] for completing various [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] of a revamped [[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="LifeDay">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68147&month=122008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed}}</ref>

This armor was originally designed to be the [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[W:c:swg:Imperial Stormtrooper|Stormtrooper]] Forest Camouflage Armor. However, due to outcry from some players regarding its perceived lack of aesthetics, the developers chose not to include that suit of armor as the player reward.<ref name="ROD">{{WebCite|url=http://www.swgalaxies.net/community/rodianrants/sept2507/index.htm|text=''Rodian Rants'': September 25, 2007|archivedate=20071013200912}}</ref> Instead, the new design which more closely resembled [[W:c:swg:Scout Trooper armor|scout trooper armor]] was used. However, unlike the scout trooper armor which was designated in [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|''Galaxies'']] as [[W:c:swg:Reconnaissance armor|reconnaissance armor]], the Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor retained its distinction as [[W:c:swg:Battle armor|battle armor]]. When examining a piece of the armor, the description read, "Imperial Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor. A recent development from Imperial Ordinance. Not routinely issued to troops."<ref name="AED" />
